description: This PHP source file defines the TimesheetMenuConfigurator class within the OrangeHRM Time module. It implements MenuConfigurator to configure menu items based on request parameters, specifically for handling timesheet views depending on user context.

classes.name: TimesheetMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Class responsible for configuring the timesheet-related menu items based on the current request context and user roles.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the menu item to display either the default timesheet view or the user-specific timesheet view based on request data.
